marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 to 25 knots increasing to northwest 30 this
morning then diminishing to northwest 15 to 20 early this evening. Wind
diminishing to light late this evening then increasing to northwest 15 to 20
Thursday morning. Wind diminishing to light Thursday afternoon. Rain this morning. Showers overnight and Thursday morning.
Fog patches forming after midnight and dissipating Thursday morning. Visibility
as low as 1 mile in rain and 1 mile or less in fog patches. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 this morning then
subsiding to 1 or less early this afternoon.<br/>
